piece.caption: Stop wasting time re-typing manual invoices. Most OCR scanning apps struggle with the reality of folded, faded, or torn thermal paper receipts common in Indian shops. Before you pay for a premium tool, test your current apps against a real-world messy receipt. Look for tools that reliably detect borders and output clean, editable text instead of gibberish. Adobe Scan is a solid choice because it turns phone numbers and URLs on receipts into clickable links, saving you from manual entry errors.
